mapper.select: SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, 'joined' as status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://example.com/default-activity.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap2.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id INNER JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap2 ON a.id = ap2.activity_id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND ap.attended = 0 AND a.status != 'finished' AND a.status = 'published' GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants ORDER BY a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time ASC

SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, 'available' as status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://example.com/default-activity.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id WHERE a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time > NOW() AND a.status = 'published' -- 排除用户已经报名的活动 AND a.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT ap_user.activity_id FROM activity_participants ap_user WHERE ap_user.user_id = #{userId} ) GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants -- 过滤掉已满员的活动（maxParticipants为NULL时永远不满员） HAVING a.max_participants IS NULL OR COALESCE(COUNT(ap.user_id), 0) < a.max_participants ORDER BY a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time ASC

SELECT a.id as activity_id, a.title, u.nickname as organizer_name, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, 'history' as status, COALESCE(a.image_url, 'https://example.com/default-activity.jpg') as image_url, a.location, COALESCE(COUNT(ap2.user_id), 0) as participant_count, a.max_participants FROM activities a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.organizer_id = u.id INNER JOIN activity_participants ap ON a.id = ap.activity_id LEFT JOIN activity_participants ap2 ON a.id = ap2.activity_id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND ap.attended = 1 GROUP BY a.id, a.title, u.nickname, a.signup_end_time_and_activity_start_time, a.activity_end_time, a.image_url, a.location, a.max_participants ORDER BY a.activity_end_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(u.avatar, 'https://example.com/default-avatar.jpg') as avatar FROM activity_participants ap LEFT JOIN users u ON ap.user_id = u.id WHERE ap.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_participants WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
